items: 壁纸配置、配额、文件校验、去重、轮换和配色全部改由插件实现，宿主只提供通用资产存储与插件 Web API。
插件前端升级到 Frontend API 1.5，只使用公开 nxp-* 组件与插件自有样式命名空间，并自动导入宿主的旧壁纸数据。
完善设置卡片展开、切换按钮与分隔线交互，修复自定义壁纸设置界面布局。
修复 Vue 前端发行产物在浏览器中无法挂载的问题。

en-US.description: Manage multiple custom wallpapers in NexusPipeline, including rotation, display effects, and adaptive colors.

items: Wallpaper settings, quotas, file validation, deduplication, rotation, and palettes are now implemented by the plugin; the host only provides generic asset storage and the plugin Web API.
The plugin frontend targets Frontend API 1.5, uses only public nxp-* elements with its own style namespace, and imports existing host wallpaper data automatically.
Refined the settings-card expansion, toggle, and separator behavior for the custom wallpaper settings UI.
Fixed the Vue frontend package so the settings card mounts in the browser.
